messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the latency/cost narrative for the benchmark post + webinar. Thinking 3 chart slices: 1) p95/p99 tail vs average; 2) cost per 1k tokens at various throughput configs; 3) throughput/GPU across model variants. Also need routing: webinar sign-up vs sales contact. Who owns the landing CTA?

sam: Love that. Can we make the cost chart show normalized $/1k tokens + shaded area for batching savings? keeps it concrete.

emily-marketing: Landing CTA: default to webinar sign-up, with an optional 'Talk to sales' for enterprise. We should A/B test the routing. I can add a hidden form field for 'company_size'.

jordan-product: For charts, add a small note about payload size assumptions (512 tokens vs 2048) — saves a lot of confusion. Also add a short textbox "real-world workloads: 75% < 512 tokens"

lee-growth: Inbound routing: recommend using utm + funnel tag -> leads go into SFDC queue 'bench-webinar' and flag MQL if company_size>100 & usage_intent=integration. I can implement rules. :thumbsup:

emily-marketing: Webinar CTA copy ideas: "See how you can cut inference costs by up to 3x while keeping latency SLOs" vs "Lower inference costs without sacrificing latency" — prefer the first?

maria: First is stronger but avoid exact numbers unless we can back them with the benchmark data. Maybe "up to 3x" if we have a slide source. Sam, can you confirm numbers?

sam: I can run the slice today. Will post the raw table in the sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BenchDraft

bench-bot: Summary saved to /marketing/benchplaybook/1766007890 — charts to include: p99 tail, cost/$1k tokens (normalized), throughput per GPU. CTA: default webinar-signup, alt 'Talk to sales'. A/B test routing for 2 weeks.

maria: Great — assign tasks: Sam = data + chart images, Emily = landing copy + form, Lee = SFDC routing, Jordan = chart annotations. Can we ship a first draft by EOD tomorrow?

sam: On it. sharing preliminary numbers by 5pm PT.

emily-marketing: I'll draft 2 CTA variants and a short thank-you email for registrants.

lee-growth: Will set up the SFDC queue and utm rules.

jordan-product: I'll add payload assumptions to each chart caption and a short FAQ blurb.

maria: Perfect. If anyone needs quick reviewer, ping @maria. :rocket:
